title: Utah Honey Harvest Festival kicks off 14th year in Grantsville
summary: The 14th Annual Utah Honey Harvest Festival began on Friday, running through Saturday evening at the Clark Historic Farm in Grantsville. Admission is $5 per person at the gate.
